name: Google Identity Services: Sign in with Google for Web
requested: Sign in with Google for Web (developers.google.com/identity/gsi/web): JS + HTML API reference, CredentialResponse, server-side ID token verification, FedCM migration, setup (origins, CSP, COOP), branding guidelines. Unversioned site, so a dated snapshot.
summary: Sign in with Google for Web (Google Identity Services JS library, gsi/client): One Tap and the button, google.accounts.id JS API and data-* HTML API reference, IdConfiguration, CredentialResponse, verifying the ID token server-side, FedCM migration, setup (client ID, authorized JavaScript origins, CSP, COOP), branding guidelines, Google OpenID Connect.
license: CC BY 4.0 (page content), Apache-2.0 (code samples), per the developers.google.com page footer

sources.ref: fetched 2026-11-23 (Google's published per-page Markdown, <page>.md.txt; page list from a link crawl of /identity/gsi/web/ cross-checked against the site navigation)

coverage: Every page in the Sign in with Google for Web section (guides, JS and HTML API references, AMP pages, release notes; 24 pages), the Sign in with Google branding guidelines, and Google's OpenID Connect page (ID token claims, discovery document). 26 pages.
gaps: The site is not versioned and the GIS JavaScript library (accounts.google.com/gsi/client) has no version number: this is a snapshot of the docs as published on 2026-11-23 (the overview page footer said 'Last updated 2026-02-10 UTC').
The interactive HTML code generator (/identity/gsi/web/tools/configurator) is not included; it is a web tool, not documentation.

Six old guide URLs (itp, subdomains, change-sign-in-context, handle-credential-responses-js-functions, receive-notifications-prompt-ui-status, toggle-display-with-cookies) now redirect into other pages (mostly display-google-one-tap and automatic-sign-in-sign-out), so they are not separate files.
Button images and branding asset downloads (icons, PNG/SVG zips) are not included; only the text of the branding guidelines.
The wider Google Identity pages (OAuth 2.0 authorization via google.accounts.oauth2, the Chrome FedCM developer docs) are linked but not mirrored.
notes: Pages were first crawled from HTML with tools/crawl.py (selector div.devsite-article-body), then each page was replaced by the Markdown Google itself publishes at <page URL>.md.txt (linked from each page as rel=alternate type=text/markdown); it keeps code-block languages and tabbed code samples the HTML extraction dropped. Front matter records source, markdown_source and fetch date. Links inside pages are absolute developers.google.com URLs, some pointing at .md.txt variants. crawl-report-branding.json is the report of the branding crawl; the 30-page gsi/web crawl report was overwritten (30 saved, 0 failed, 1 skipped). No embedded instructions aimed at AI agents were found.
